connector.name: MCP by wireboard
connector.registryDescription: Official MCP server for WireBoard. Lets LLM agents query your analytics in conversation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wireboard account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Your WireBoard API bearer token. Mint one at https://wireboard.io/dashboard/settings/api with the analytics:read and live:read abilities.
